acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce a writer waiting behind a concurrently advanced receipt and establish whether recordedAt is sampled before acquiring the writer lock.
If confirmed, sample transaction time at the safe writer boundary while retaining genuine backward-clock refusal and no-write guarantees; add a deterministic contention regression.
Retain exact version, observed evidence, uncertainty and focused verification.
body:
Suspected concurrency defect, not yet minimized. On 2026-09-30, installed Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202 refused the first narrow V1-0528 claim with STORAGE_FAILED/MALFORMED: transaction recordedAt 13:10:36 UTC was earlier than head receipt 13:10:38 UTC while another writer was active. No receipt or attempt was produced; retrying the unchanged request succeeded at generation42 / receipt1255. Expected: ordinary lock wait/concurrent head advancement should not look like a clock rollback. Actual clock rollback was NOT_OBSERVED. Preserve the CAL-V0 clock-backward safety rule. Evidence: /private/tmp/corvint-opencode-ux-build/plan.md and attempt:corvint:main:2f5e382fd74390757984444951b5ec73. Search for recordedAt/timestamp/journal found no matching intake ticket.

2026-10-02 additional release witness, still not a minimized product-defect proof: installed Tasks build202 refused generation129 release under concurrent writers with STORAGE_FAILED/MALFORMED recordedAt 13:32:17Z earlier than head13:32:18Z. Owned source builder had completed/no processes; no active frozen gate. No release receipt was allocated. Receipt audit1956 CONSISTENT/AGREES, no staging, owned129 remained RUNNING. Fresh supported request with the same attempt/generation/reason succeeded1957 and readback CANCELLED/ADJUDICATION/FENCED. Actual host-clock rollback NOT_OBSERVED; preserve backward-clock refusal and all CAL0012 invariants, not a bypass. This shows release as well as claim susceptibility in installed developer build; public MAIN WithClock source and selected tests are separate evidence, not proof that installed runtime contains/qualifies the fix. Raw receipts/logs /private/tmp/corvint-codex-batch.S53nDh/456-fixture-release.json, audit-456-release-clock-refusal.json,456-release-clock-attempt.json,456-fixture-release-retry1.json. Tool-wrapper latency cause NOT_OBSERVED.

## Additional observed renewal witness, #397 code phase, 2026-10-02
Installed Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202. Canonical primary renew of owned attempt attempt:corvint:main:793693aa8714fa18c3f354a6068c2d9b generation146, request corvint-397-code-review-window-20261002 with lease45: outcome REFUSED/STORAGE_FAILED (process exit0), warning MALFORMED transaction recordedAt 2026-10-02T17:31:11Z earlier than head receipt 2026-10-02T17:31:12Z. Original command result /private/tmp/corvint-397-code-renew-time-race-refusal.json. Audit2037 remained CONSISTENT/AGREES with stagingPresent false; original attempt stayed RUNNING with its prior lease. The exact same request ID/arguments retried after readback succeeded at receipt2038 and extended the same generation to18:16:54Z. No store/identity/source changes or recovery/verification bypass. This additional concurrent-write observation is deduplicated to the existing issue, not a new queue item or a repair in #397. Retain the failed command and successful retry as reproduction evidence; expected normal authorized renewal should not produce a malformed transaction solely because another writer advanced the head after its timestamp was selected.


## Additional submit witness, V1-0655 closeout, 2026-10-03
Installed Tasks build202 refused submit of generation213 (attempt:corvint:main:eb3eb848d68cba6ab3fc413e1d8a84e1) with process exit0 / REFUSED / STORAGE_FAILED: transaction recordedAt 13:27:41Z earlier than head receipt 13:27:44Z. Actual argv used default CLI timestamp, with no explicit time supplied. ROOT concurrently wrote observation refinements receipts2273/2274; causal lock timing and genuine host clock rollback remain NOT_OBSERVED. Raw submit and original command/evidence: /private/tmp/dispatch-468-native-closeout/submit.json and FINAL.md; submit SHA256 recorded in SHA256SUMS. No submission receipt, gate or completion occurred under213. Ordinary return2275 CANCELLED/FENCED; audit2275 CONSISTENT/AGREES, no pending redo/staging. Fresh ordinary closeout admission under214 submitted and passed focused-docs while ROOT native writes were serialized. No safety-clock relaxation or manual completion bypass. Deduplicated into existing suspected concurrency defect; this observation extends affected verbs to submit, not a minimized new root-cause proof.
